name: learning
summary: /refresh-knowledge did not re-extract: it re-asserted a stale oracle with a fresh timestamp, and because it never touched _extracted-codebase.md the approved_hash never mismatched, so health reported the stale oracle green. It now invokes extract-codebase-overview (chaining extract-business-context) + extract-base-class-idiom, preserves the approval stamp so the mismatch fires, and diffs oracle-vs-oracle. [CONTESTED] and MEDIUM had zero consumers on the path every project takes - convention-drift-detector flagged the minority side of a measured 6/4 split as FIX CODE; both now have consumers. ## Cross-cutting concerns and ## Anti-patterns observed were outside check 7 while emitting 'confirmed' and bare counts; both gained denominator rows and a three-word verdict grammar. Specificity became a positive test after a blocklist let confident prose score 25/25. The _examples/ directory is deleted (-1,632 lines, source-as-fallback), which removed three shipped fallbacks that had dropped their destination sections and re-introduced stack leakage.
